results.title: UFP Technologies executive chairman Bailly sells $4.1m in shares
Anthropic’s Stunning $11.5 Billion Quarter Signals AI’s Arrival as Big Business
results.description: Anthropic reported over $11.5 billion in Q2 2026 revenue, a 14x jump from the prior year, while posting positive adjusted operating income for the first time. The surge, fueled by enterprise adoption of Claude coding tools, aligns with its $47 billion run-rate and massive funding rounds. This marks a pivotal shift for the AI industry from heavy losses to scalable profits.
